claim: the published v0.7.2 tag, installed by a stranger path (npm install github:auroraxo/reeflog#v0.7.2 into an empty directory + bootstrap()), refuses a non-numeric or negative flag VALUE before opening or creating anything

install.command: npm install github:auroraxo/reeflog#v0.7.2 (empty dir) -> import { bootstrap } from 'reeflog-client'; await bootstrap()

setup.journal: fresh init in an empty directory, 650 seeded rows (insert through the journal's own table)

cases.expected: refusal naming the flag and the value, exit != 0, no cursor created
cases.observed: exit 1, stderr: reeflog: error: flag --limit expects a non-negative whole number, got `abc` — not a number (e.g. --limit 10)

cases.expected: refusal (SQLite reads LIMIT -1 as UNLIMITED; the default was every row)
cases.observed: exit 1, stderr names --limit and -1, 0 lines of output

cases.case: tail --limit 5 (guard: a legal value must keep working)
cases.expected: exit 0, exactly 5 rows, cursor advanced to 5
cases.observed: exit 0, '5 events after cursor 0 -> cursor now 5', 5 rows, cursor file c3.txt created

baseline.note: the same cases against the published v0.7.1 binary are measured in research/numeric-flag-values-2026-11-08.json: baseline 4/10 cases behave as specified, 2 'refusals' delivered all 650 rows

limits: one host, one account, own measurement (no third-party run)
npm package 'reeflog-client' is still not published to the npm registry (ENEEDAUTH); the stranger path is the GitHub install
the value check covers values that reach the flag parser; values coming from configuration are not covered
